children: Motorbike sales in Indonesia increased 3.18% year-on-year to 596,461 units in August 2026, slowing from an 8.3% rise in the previous month.
The Association of Indonesian Motorcycle Industry (AISI) expects sales to remain relatively stable at around 6.4 million to 6.7 million units this year.

Last year, motorbike sales climbed 1.3% to 6.4 million units, within the target range of 6.4 million to 6.7 million units set by AISI. However, the growth rate was slightly slower than the 1.5% increase recorded in 2024.
On a monthly basis, motorbike sales fell 6.2% in August, reversing sharply from a 23.0% surge in July.

title: Indonesia Motorbike Sales Rise 3.18% in August
